claim: In a game with no frame wait, make the loop cheaper (for example by compiling known sprites to Z80 code); time saved in the game's own logic pays for Layer 2 work.

evidence.text: The game has no frame wait, so its time is its pace; every known sprite is compiled to Z80 code, with a table walk for any other source; two K windows run at 28 MHz (8692-8374, the draw from A2C3 to A605).
evidence.quote: Every known sprite is compiled to Z80 code (`compiled()`), with a table walk for any other source.
